correctness.rationale: Independently re-verified with Python (sympy 1.12, Fractions) from inputs/artifacts/*.json. (1) F-recurrence: rebuilt F_n via F_{n+1}=F_n^2+c from F_1=[1,0]; matches stored F_1..F_7 exactly (degs 1,2,4,8,16,32,64 = 2^{n-1}). (2) Dynatomic identity: F_4 = P1*P2*P4 and F_6 = P1*P2*P3*P6 exactly (polynomial multiplication); prime cases c*P_n == F_n for n=2,3,5,7. Degrees P_4=6,P_5=15,P_6=27,P_7=63 match Moebius sum. All logged remainders 0 confirmed by identity. (3) Escape lemma: proof checked — c>0 gives x_k>0; c<-2 gives |x_1|>2 and g(t)=t^2-t-|c| with g(|c|)=|c|(|c|-2)>0 and g'>0 for t>2, so |x_k| strictly increasing, never 0. Valid. (4) Exact-period correspondence: verified gcd(P4,P1)=gcd(P4,P2)=gcd(P5,P1)=gcd(P6,P1)=gcd(P6,P2)=gcd(P6,P3)=gcd(P7,P1)=1 (sympy gcd, all 1) and discriminants nonzero (see below), so separability holds; divisor argument n=qd+r => r=0 valid. Bijection P_n roots <-> exact-period-n centers holds. (5) Sturm: recomputed sympy.sturm() lengths 7,16,28,64 ending in nonzero constants; V(-oo)-V(+oo)=4-2=2, 9-6=3, 16-11=5, 36-27=9; V(-2)-V(0) identical, so all real roots lie in [-2,0]; combined with Escape lemma no centers missed. Per-interval Sturm counts recomputed by exact Fraction Horner on sympy Sturm polynomials: all 19 intervals have Va-Vb=1. Disjointness/sortedness, widths 1/2^34 ~=5.82e-11 <=1e-10, containment in [-2,0], and exact endpoint sign changes P_n(a)*P_n(b)<0 all re-verified with Fractions. Residuals |F_n(mid)|,|P_n(mid)| <1e-6 (observed max ~1.8e-08) re-verified. (6) Q-irreducibility: sympy factor_list gives single factor mult 1 for each P_n (degs 6,15,27,63); discriminants recomputed exactly match draft: 58673, 319210993681318817, -1041479942838787424502668691138595310951, -153520438551539200635009419307199073882244641478128015821165293535598058722242376398611282776948544829749027404671 (376-bit for P7). (7) Kneading: replayed naive Fraction interval orbit X_{k+1}=X_k^2+C with straddling-square rule; all 19 intervals have strictly signed X_k for k<n and X_n containing 0; words match published table and are distinct within each n; midpoint orbits match interval words; min|x_k| 0.105-1.4 >0.01 threshold. (8) Witness I*_8: midpoint == interval midpoint, 7-step Fraction orbit replays exactly, residual ~4.3e-10, interval orbit X_1..X_6 strictly signed word -+----, X_7 contains 0. Proof of exact center in interval via Sturm-count-1 + sign change + gcd + separability is valid; multiplier-0 argument (cycle contains 0 where f'=2x=0) is valid. Draft honestly notes midpoint itself is not exact and 'minimal |disc|' is degenerate (single factor). Floats only for display. No essential inference, boundary condition, or computation found incorrect. Residual trust is in sympy exact algorithms (sturm/factor/discriminant/gcd), partially cross-checked by stdlib replay of consequences.

originality.rationale: Searched arXiv/Crossref independently (queries: dynatomic+quadratic, Gleason+dynatomic, Gleason+unicritical, hyperbolic+center+Mandelbrot, real quadratic kneading). Nearest priors: (a) Vigneron-Mihalache arXiv:2402.06083 (2024) 'How to split a tera-polynomial' — computes ALL hyperbolic centers period <=41 (degree ~1e12) with certified database (723k core-hours); subsumes period 4-7 locations/counts as a tiny subset but does not ship the exact closed package claimed here (Sturm sequences + per-interval Sturm-1 certificates + monic Q-irreducible minimal polynomials + 376-bit discriminants + 19 stable kneading words + exact Fraction interval orbits + stdlib verifier). (b) Buff-Lei 'quadratic dynatomic curves are smooth and irreducible' (2014) + Gao-Ou extension to z^d+c (2013) — prove smoothness/irreducibility of complex curves (c,z) via quadratic differentials/kneading, no real-root census, no isolating intervals, no minimal-polynomial/discriminant/orbit-replay table. Curve irreducibility does not imply univariate Gleason specialization P_n(c) irreducible. (c) Krumm arXiv:1707.02501 (Galois groups of Phi_{4,f}) and Zhang arXiv:1610.00807 (Galois-dynamics for unicritical, no quadratic period 5/6 points) — arithmetic/Galois, not real Sturm census. (d) Reduction of dynatomic curves Y1(n) mod p (n=7,8,11) — good/bad reduction, not real isolation. No retrieved source publishes verbatim the 19 disjoint 1e-10 Fraction intervals + 4 discriminants + kneading table + verifier for periods 4-7. Gleason coefficients themselves are classical and real counts 2,3,5,9 are implied by (a), so novelty is narrow (packaging + Sturm/Q-factor/kneading certification, not objects). Because verbatim package was not found, originality narrowly PASSES; the subsumption by (a) is counted under value, not verbatim duplication.

value.rationale: Even though correct and formally new as a package, the result is not independently worth finding later. (1) Objects are classical: Gleason/center polynomials F_n,P_n for x^2+c have been known since the 1980s; coefficients for n<=7 recompute in milliseconds and factor in 0.001-0.03s; discriminants are bare integers with no stated application, and with single irreducible factor per n there is no discriminant ordering — draft Sec.6/8 admits 'minimal |disc|' is degenerate and retreats to rightmost center (maximal c) as canonical choice, whose 'smallest residual' is a bisection artifact, not an intrinsic extremum. No genuine extremal discovery. (2) Scope is a tiny subset of an existing certified census: Vigneron-Mihalache (2024) already certifies ALL hyperbolic centers to period 41 (tera-polynomial) with public database; a period 4-7 real slice (<2s total, well under a minute) is a small-range restriction with no new method — exact division + sympy Sturm + dyadic bisection + naive interval arithmetic are textbook computational algebra. (3) No surprise or consequence: kneading words are distinct within each n as expected for distinct real centers; no admissibility classification, no Galois/external-angle result, no conjecture resolved, no constant improved, explicitly no claim for n>=8, complex centers, or Galois groups. Counts 2,3,5,9 follow the expected ~2^{n-1}/n growth and are implied by the larger database. (4) This is therefore a small unexplained enumeration with standard-tool certification and a degenerate witness: textbook computation + tiny unmotivated gain over a much larger certified table. It does not meet the 'independently worth finding later' bar; value FAILS.
